title: Palmer Penguins
text:
This project explores data about penguins. I will compare the flipper lengths of different penguin species using a visualization.



penguins <- readr::read_csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2020/2020-07-28/penguins.csv"
)




This boxplot compares the flipper lengths of Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo penguins.

ggplot2::ggplot(
  penguins,
  ggplot2::aes(x = species, y = flipper_length_mm)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Flipper Length by Penguin Species",
    x = "Penguin Species",
    y = "Flipper Length (mm)"
  )

title: Palm Trees
text:
Visualize the data
This graph shows the 10 most common palm tree genera in the dataset.

top_genera <- palmtrees |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(acc_genus)) |>
  dplyr::count(acc_genus, sort = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)

ggplot2::ggplot(
  top_genera,
  ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(acc_genus, n), y = n)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col() +
  ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "10 Most Common Palm Tree Genera",
    x = "Genus",
    y = "Number of Records"
  )
